_comment: Final lines of cutscene/UI text files that the extractor previously missed (string ended at EOF without padding). Fan translation.

id./param/scenario/cs/a_010_cs_080.pack|cs_: Oh no... it's started raining. Let's hurry, {var:1}.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_010_cs_090.pack|cs_: Everyone will be waiting for us to get back.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_010_cs_110.pack|cs_: Right! The whole village is gathering to see you off! Come along when you're ready!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_010_cs_130.pack|cs_: My apologies for earlier. The King is expecting you, so please, go on in.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_020_cs_030.pack|cs_: Right, let's get out of here before more guards show up. Give me a shout when you're ready.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_020_cs_050.pack|cs_: The sewers, huh. There's gotta be a way out somewhere. I'll watch our backs. You go on ahead.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_020_cs_055.pack|cs_: Looks like guards are on patrol... Let's avoid any pointless fights and sneak through carefully.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_020_cs_070.pack|cs_: We might be able to get out up ahead. Let's keep going.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_020_cs_080.pack|cs_: We can't beat that thing in a straight fight! Run for it!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_020_cs_090.pack|cs_: Oh, come on! Seriously?! Run, Luminary!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_020_cs_095.pack|cs_: Oh, come on! Seriously?! Run, Luminary!
id./param/scenario/cs/a_030_cs_010.pack|cs_: We can't just lie around resting... but first, let's thank the sister who helped us.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_030_cs_020.pack|cs_: {var:1}, how about we get some fresh air and talk about what comes next?
id./param/scenario/cs/a_030_cs_031.pack|cs_: ...Right, take the materials for that recipe I gave you. Try making a weapon with them.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_030_cs_040.pack|cs_: Right, let's go and get it. The rubbish heap's just through here.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_030_cs_050.pack|cs_: Up ahead is the lodging house we used to hole up in. It's two storeys, so you can't miss it. Let's head there first.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_030_cs_085.pack|cs_: Right, {var:1}, now's our chance. Let's get up into town.
id./param/scenario/cs/a_030_cs_100.pack|cs_: ...The Manglegrove, huh? Heard they're wild. But it's the only way. Fine, bring it on.
id./script/a_020.pack|ie.bxon|72c: A mysterious force has returned you to the Heliodor sewers.
